class.name: TTSServer
class.brief_description: Server for text to speech with voice personas.

method.name: add_persona
method.description: Adds [param persona] to the persona list under its [member TTSPersona.persona_name]. A persona with the same name is replaced. Reports an error if [param persona] is [code]null[/code] or has no name.

method.name: clear_persona_overrides
method.description: Removes all of the player's persona overrides and the player's default persona (see [method set_default_persona_override]). The personas of the game are used again.

method.name: clear_personas
method.description: Removes all personas of the game from the list and resets the game's default persona to the built-in one. The player's overrides are kept (see [method clear_persona_overrides]).

method.name: get_base_persona
method.description: Returns the persona of the game called [param name], without the player's override, or [code]null[/code] if the game has no such persona. Use it to show the original values or to start an override from them.

method.name: get_default_persona
method.description: Returns the persona used by [method speak] when no persona is given. This is the persona named by [method set_default_persona_override] if it exists, otherwise the persona set with [method set_default_persona], otherwise a built-in persona with default values (system language, volume [code]50[/code], pitch and rate [code]1.0[/code]). The player's override of that persona is returned if there is one.

method.name: get_default_persona_name
method.description: Returns the name of the persona returned by [method get_default_persona]: the player's default persona if it exists, otherwise the name set with [method set_default_persona], or an empty [StringName] if the built-in persona is used.

method.name: get_default_persona_override
method.description: Returns the name set with [method set_default_persona_override], or an empty [StringName] if the player has not chosen a default persona.

method.name: get_pending_utterances
method.description: Returns the IDs of the utterances started with [method speak] that have not ended or been canceled yet, sorted in ascending order. This includes the utterance being spoken and the ones waiting in the queue.

method.name: get_persona
method.description: Returns the persona called [param name]: the player's override if there is one (see [method set_persona_override]), otherwise the persona of the game. Returns [code]null[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_persona_names
method.description: Returns the names of all personas: the personas of the game in the order they were added, then the personas only the player has.

method.name: get_persona_override
method.description: Returns the player's override called [param name], or [code]null[/code] if the player has not changed or created this persona.

method.name: get_persona_overrides
method.description: Returns all of the player's persona overrides, in the order they were set.

method.name: get_personas
method.description: Returns all personas as [method get_persona] returns them: the personas of the game in the order they were added (each replaced by the player's override if there is one), then the personas only the player has.

method.name: get_voices
method.description: Returns the voices of the system, like [method DisplayServer.tts_get_voices]. Each [Dictionary] has the keys [code]"name"[/code], [code]"id"[/code] and [code]"language"[/code]. If [param language] is not empty, only voices of that language are returned: [code]"en"[/code] matches every English voice, [code]"en_US"[/code] only American English. Hyphens and underscores are treated the same. Returns an empty array if text to speech is not available. [b]Note:[/b] On the Web, the browser loads its voice list asynchronously. The first call may return an empty array.

method.name: has_persona
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there is a persona called [param name], of the game or of the player.

method.name: has_persona_override
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the player has an override called [param name].

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if text to speech can be used: [member ProjectSettings.audio/general/text_to_speech] is enabled and the current [DisplayServer] supports [constant DisplayServer.FEATURE_TEXT_TO_SPEECH].

method.name: is_paused
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the synthesizer is paused. Returns [code]false[/code] if text to speech is not available.

method.name: is_speaking
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the synthesizer is generating speech or has utterances in its queue. Returns [code]false[/code] if text to speech is not available.

method.name: pause
method.description: Pauses the synthesizer. Does nothing if text to speech is not available. [b]Note:[/b] On Android, pausing stops the utterance, and [method resume] speaks it again from the last word boundary.

method.name: remove_persona
method.description: Removes the persona called [param name]. If it was the default persona, the built-in persona becomes the default again. Does nothing if there is no such persona.

method.name: remove_persona_override
method.description: Removes the player's override called [param name]. If the game has a persona with this name, it is used again. Does nothing if there is no such override.

method.name: resolve_voice_id
method.description: Returns the voice ID that [method speak] would use for [param persona] (or the default persona if [code]null[/code]) on this machine: 1. [member TTSPersona.voice], if a voice with this ID or name exists. 2. Otherwise the first voice for [member TTSPersona.language], first with the same region, then with any region. 3. Otherwise the first voice for the language of the system ([method OS.get_locale]). 4. Otherwise the first voice of the system. If the system reports no voices at all (text to speech not available, or the Web voice list is still loading), [member TTSPersona.voice] is returned unchanged and the platform decides.

method.name: resume
method.description: Resumes a paused synthesizer. Does nothing if text to speech is not available.

method.name: set_default_persona
method.description: Makes the persona called [param name] the default persona of the game for [method speak]. The persona must exist (added with [method add_persona] or [method set_persona_override]). An empty [param name] resets the default to the built-in persona. The player's default persona ([method set_default_persona_override]) still comes first.

method.name: set_default_persona_override
method.description: Sets the player's default persona. It comes before the default persona of the game as long as a persona with this name exists; the name is not checked, so it may name a persona the game adds later. An empty [param name] removes the player's choice. [b]Note:[/b] [TTSPersonaSettingsServer] calls this method; games usually change [method TTSPersonaSettingsServer.set_default_persona] instead, which is saved.

method.name: set_persona_override
method.description: Sets the player's version of the persona called [member TTSPersona.persona_name]. It replaces the persona of the game with the same name for [method get_persona], [method speak_with_persona] and the default persona, without removing it (see [method get_base_persona]). A persona only the player has is added this way too. An override with the same name is replaced. Reports an error if [param persona] is [code]null[/code] or has no name. [b]Note:[/b] [TTSPersonaSettingsServer] calls this method; games usually change [TTSPersonaSettingsServer] instead, which is saved.

method.name: speak
method.description: Adds [param text] to the queue of the synthesizer, spoken with [param persona], or with [method get_default_persona] if [code]null[/code]. The voice is chosen with [method resolve_voice_id]. If [member TTSPersona.interrupt] is [code]true[/code], the current utterance and the queue are canceled first. Returns the ID of the utterance, a positive number that is used by the [code]utterance_*[/code] signals. Returns [code]-1[/code] and reports an error if [param text] is empty or text to speech is not available (see [method is_available]).

method.name: speak_with_persona
method.description: Speaks [param text] like [method speak] with the persona called [param persona_name] (the player's override if there is one, see [method get_persona]). If there is no such persona, a warning is printed and the default persona is used; an empty [param persona_name] uses the default persona without a warning. Returns the ID of the utterance, or [code]-1[/code] like [method speak].

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the current utterance and clears the queue. The platform emits [signal utterance_canceled] for each canceled utterance. Does nothing if text to speech is not available.

signal.name: utterance_boundary
signal.description: Emitted when the synthesizer reaches a word boundary in utterance [param id]. [param char_pos] is the position of the character in the text. [b]Note:[/b] Not every platform and voice reports word boundaries.

signal.name: utterance_canceled
signal.description: Emitted when utterance [param id] is canceled, by [method stop], by a persona with [member TTSPersona.interrupt], or by the system.

signal.name: utterance_ended
signal.description: Emitted when utterance [param id] has been spoken completely.

signal.name: utterance_started
signal.description: Emitted when the synthesizer starts to speak utterance [param id].
